confirmedFindings.title: Inverted Callback Parameters Break Error Propagation
confirmedFindings.body: Inverting callback parameter order from error-first (err, transferId) to (transferId, err) violates Node.js conventions and breaks sipServer.ts which checks `if (err)` on the first argument, treating error objects as successful transfer IDs.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Maintain standard Node.js error-first callback signature (err, result) or migrate to async/Promise.
